The '''Tyus sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Tyus Cluster/Legends|Tyus Cluster]], an almost unnavigable cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]].
